# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.0

## 2026-11-10

This stable release brings the native C300X display to Home Assistant: a
dashboard with real entity controls, HA-owned notifications and a
context-sensitive Alarmo page, all in the original blue design. It also carries
the security and lifecycle corrections that accumulated since 2.0.0.

The device agent is rebuilt as **2.1.0** and has to be updated.

## Native Display

- A dashboard page shows lights, covers, climate entities, fans and sensors in
  a two-column overview. Tiles with a submenu open from anywhere on the tile;
  lights and fans also carry an on/off switch on the tile itself.
- Lights offer brightness, color swatches and bounded white presets on separate
  white and color tabs. Covers show the actual position with fixed up, stop and
  down controls. Climate entities report activity separately from HVAC mode and
  expose the supported fan, swing and preset modes. Fans expose speed,
  oscillation, presets and direction. Sensors get larger readings and selected
  supplementary values.
- Sliders send on release and state updates are event-driven, so no periodic
  device polling is added. Command feedback distinguishes sending, accepted
  commands and state confirmed by HA; an accepted command that HA never
  reflects is reported as unconfirmed rather than left standing.
- Pages, entity positions and labels are configured in the existing Home
  Assistant dialogs.

## Notifications and Alarmo

- Home Assistant owns the display notifications: stable IDs, a bounded priority
  queue, expiry, explicit dismissal and up to two allowlisted actions. A
  calendar reminder blueprint is included. Nothing wakes the display or
  overlays PIN entry or calls.
- The Alarmo subpage shows the PIN keypad only when it is needed, including
  during entry delay. Modes without a PIN execute directly. An optional Alarmo
  quick entity can be left empty to hide the action.

## Camera Microphone

- Optional native Home Assistant camera microphone support on HA 2026.11+,
  disabled by default. It needs the integration option, HA Labs Two-way audio,
  WebRTC, HTTPS and microphone permission. Card talkback is unchanged and needs
  no agent update.

## Fixed Since 2.0.0

- Agent configuration changes require the existing maintenance credential; the
  API token can neither enable maintenance nor replace its token.
- Home Call WebSocket commands enforce camera control permission, ICE
  candidates are bound to their originating subscription, and C300X services
  enforce HA caller permissions while preserving the caller's context.
- WebRTC offers are cancelled on stop and media-end, late provider callbacks
  are discarded, and camera setup is cancelled when the player closes.
- Ring captures are reserved atomically before an unlock attempt and all used
  IDs survive a restart, so a capture cannot be replayed.
- Agent updates are validated completely before installation and roll back on
  an apply failure.
- The legacy Paramiko installer is replaced by current AsyncSSH, with
  device-required legacy algorithms scoped to explicit bootstrap and recovery.
- Display commands are forwarded asynchronously, removing a callback deadlock,
  and complete request targets and options are preserved.
- HTTP errors, empty responses and incomplete display callback headers no
  longer report Home Assistant as connected.
- Ringer status verification waits for device confirmation instead of feeding
  the previous mute state back into the GUI.

The complete list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0/CHANGELOG.md).

## Update

1. In Marketplace or HACS, open the integration menu and choose **Redownload**,
   then select **2.1.0**. Coming from a 2.1.0 beta, disable the prerelease
   option afterwards.
2. Restart Home Assistant.
3. Complete the agent-update Repair. It installs the rebuilt agent **2.1.0**.
4. Apply the **Display patch**, including when upgrading from a 2.1.0 beta.
   Applying it restarts the device GUI.

Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum. Existing integration entries and
card configurations can be kept.

## Validation

- The display layer is covered by source contract tests and a JavaScript
  harness; local tests do not execute the device's Qt runtime. Confirm the
  dashboard, standby return and interruption by a physical Ring Call on the
  actual C300X.
- Ringer feedback corrections are covered by local tests. Confirmation with the
  corrected agent on affected devices is still open (issue #65).

See [beta and update guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0/docs/advanced-maintenance.md#beta-versions)
and [display controls](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-bticino-c300x/blob/v2.1.0/docs/feature-reference.md#display-device-controls).
